headline: Full Mouth Rehabilitation in Beverly Hills
support: Worn, damaged or missing teeth, planned as one complete restoration with crowns, bridges, veneers and smile makeovers. Dr. Nushin Shir treats you, not just your teeth.
formNote: What your mouth needs is decided at the examination. Your request is not a confirmed appointment. Our team will contact you about availability.

focus.heading: One plan for your whole smile
focus.intro: Full mouth rehabilitation looks at how your teeth, gums and bite work together, then restores them as a whole instead of one tooth at a time. After your examination, your plan may include:
items: Porcelain crowns, made from a digital scan and shaded to your own teeth
Dental bridges, to replace missing teeth with a fixed restoration
Porcelain veneers, to reshape and refine the front of your smile
A smile makeover, planned around your face and your goals

image.alt: The waiting lounge at Beverly Hills Dental Arts Studio, with a white leather chair and a mirrored console

items.title: Examination and imaging
items.text: Dr. Shir looks at your teeth, gums and bite, with imaging taken in this office.

items.title: Your whole-mouth plan
items.text: You go over your options in plain language, with the timing and cost explained before you decide.

items.title: Your treatment
items.text: Your care is carried out as planned, with one team who knows your history.

items.title: Final fit and follow-up
items.text: Your restorations are fitted and checked with you, and your ongoing care is planned.

faqs.a: It is a complete plan to restore the health, function and appearance of your teeth together. It can include crowns, bridges, veneers and other restorations, depending on what your examination shows.
Dr. Shir will tell you after an examination. Some people need only a few restorations, and she will explain your options before anything begins.

faqs.q: Will it take more than one visit?
faqs.a: Because the plan covers your whole mouth, care is usually planned across more than one visit. Dr. Shir explains the timing before you decide.
Costs depend on your assessment and the treatment in your plan. Ask the team for a written plan before you decide.

closing.heading: Start with a conversation
closing.text: Request a free consultation and our team will contact you about availability.

title: Gum Health and Gum Disease Treatment in Beverly Hills | Beverly Hills Dental Arts Studio
headline: Gum Health and Gum Disease Treatment in Beverly Hills
support: Bleeding, swollen or receding gums? Dr. Nushin Shir cares for your gums with your whole health in view, from deep cleaning to ongoing periodontal maintenance.
formNote: What your gums need is decided at the examination. Your request is not a confirmed appointment. Our team will contact you about availability.

focus.heading: Care for your gums, at every stage
focus.intro: Healthy gums support your teeth, and gum health is connected to the rest of your health. After an examination, your care may include:
items: A gum evaluation, with digital X-rays and a check of your gums and the bone around your teeth
Deep cleaning (scaling and root planing), which cleans below the gumline
Ozone therapy and soft-tissue laser care, used alongside conventional treatment where suitable
Periodontal maintenance, regular visits to help keep your gums healthy over time

image.alt: The lobby at Beverly Hills Dental Arts Studio, with a round table and spring blossoms and a treatment room beyond

items.title: Gum examination
items.text: Dr. Shir checks your gums and teeth, with digital X-rays taken in the office.

items.title: Your options
items.text: You go over what your gums need and why, in plain language.

items.title: Your treatment
items.text: Deep cleaning and any other care in your plan are carried out as agreed with you.

items.title: Keeping your gums healthy
items.text: A maintenance schedule is set for you, so your care continues with a team who knows your history.

faqs.q: What are signs of gum disease?
faqs.a: Bleeding when you brush or floss, red or swollen gums, gums pulling away from the teeth, ongoing bad breath or teeth that feel loose. Gum disease is often painless in its early stages, so an examination matters.

faqs.q: What is scaling and root planing?
faqs.a: A deep cleaning that removes plaque and tartar from below the gumline and smooths the root surfaces. Whether you need it is decided at your examination.
Regular cleanings after gum treatment, to help keep your gums healthy. Dr. Shir sets how often you come in, based on your needs.
Costs depend on your assessment and the treatment in your plan. Ask the team for an estimate before you decide.

closing.heading: Get your gums checked
closing.text: Request a free consultation and our team will contact you about availability.
